# lit-material

> A Material Design 3 web component collection built with Lit — one package per component, no shared
> mega-bundle, no required adapter layer, SSR-ready.

lit-material is a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo published as independently installable `@lit-material/*` npm
packages (one per component, all released at the same version), plus a handful of app-shell primitives (router, state store, context, data
fetching, form validation) and a scaffolding CLI. Every component reads its visual design from
`@lit-material/tokens`'s CSS custom properties, is tested against both a real browser and `@lit-labs/ssr`, and
is documented with a live demo in `apps/docs`. Each package's own README is the source of truth for its API and
scope cuts — read it before assuming something is missing or unimplemented.

Every component package also exports generated framework bindings: `@lit-material/<pkg>/react` (React wrappers on
`@lit/react`; events as `onChange`-style props), `@lit-material/<pkg>/jsx` (React 19 JSX typings, load with
`import type {} from ...`; event props are `on` + the event name as written), `@lit-material/<pkg>/vue` (Vue
`GlobalComponents` typings), and `dist/web-types.json` / `dist/vscode.html-custom-data.json` for editors.

## Components

- [Button](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/button): Filled, outlined, text, elevated, tonal. `lit-material-action-list` — `align="start|end|between"`, `compact`, `label` (role=group); nest for groups.
- [Icon Button](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/icon-button): Standard + toggle variants.
- [FAB](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/fab): Floating action button.
- [Text Field](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/text-field): Single-line + `lit-material-textarea` multi-line, filled + outlined, validation states; `lit-material-number-field` (−/+ steppers, min/max/step, unit, range errors in words); `lit-material-input-group` joins outlined fields, selects and buttons; `lit-material-one-time-code` (`length`, `group-size`, `alphanumeric`, fires `complete`) from `@lit-material/text-field/one-time-code.js`.
- [Checkbox](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/checkbox): Checked, indeterminate, error, form participation.
- [Radio](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/radio): Grouped selection, error, form participation.
- [Switch](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/switch): On/off toggle, optional thumb icons, form participation.
- [Slider](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/slider): Single value, native `<input type="range">`-based.
- [Select](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/select): `lit-material-select` + `lit-material-select-option`.
- [Chip](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/chip): Assist, filter, input, suggestion variants; `lit-material-chip-input` (`.values`, Enter/comma/paste adds, `validator`, `change` `{values}`).
- [Segmented Button](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/segmented-button): Single-select or multi-select connected button row.
- [Card](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/card): Elevated, filled, outlined; optionally interactive.
- [Carousel](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/carousel): Scroll-snap based, with overlaid nav buttons.
- [List](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/list): `lit-material-list` + `lit-material-list-item`.
- [Data Table](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/data-table): Sortable, selectable, paginated, resizable, virtualized; `lit-material-data-grid` adds grouping with aggregates, inline editing and CSV export.
- [Badge](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/badge): Small dot or large numeric/text badge.
- [Divider](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/divider): Horizontal or vertical, optionally inset.
- [Tooltip](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/tooltip): Plain tooltip, built on the native Popover API.
- [Dialog](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/dialog): Built on the native `<dialog>` element. `lit-material-about-dialog` — `product-name`, slots `logo`/default (details)/`legal`, `show()`/`close()`.
- [Sheet](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/sheet): Side sheet and bottom sheet; same native `<dialog>` foundation.
- [Menu](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/menu): Built on the native Popover API. `lit-material-app-launcher` — grid button + menu of `lit-material-list-item href` apps; `searchable`, `label`.
- [Search](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/search): Search bar and docked search view; view built on the native Popover API.
- [Kbd](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/kbd): `lit-material-kbd` — `keys` (`Mod+K`, `Mod+Shift+P`, `G I` sequence), `platform` auto|apple|other (auto detected after hydration; server renders non-Apple), `size` small|medium; spoken names translated (`kbd.*`); `parseShortcut()`, `isApplePlatform()` exported.
- [Command palette](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/command-palette): `lit-material-command-palette` — modal ⌘K search on native `<dialog>`; `.items` `[{id, label, section?, hint?, keywords?, shortcut?, disabled?}]`, `.prefixes` `{">": "Commands"}` limit to a section, `placeholder`, `label`, `open`/`show()`/`hide()`; fuzzy match (`fuzzyMatch` exported) with highlight, grouped by section; ARIA combobox + listbox; events `select` `{item, query}`, `close`, cancelable `tab` `{query}`; binds no global keys; focus returns on close.
- [Snackbar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/snackbar): Built on the native Popover API.
- [Tabs](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/tabs): `lit-material-tabs` + `lit-material-tab`, optional `lit-material-tab-panel` siblings paired by index.
- [Top App Bar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/top-app-bar): Center-aligned, small, medium, large.
- [Navigation](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/navigation): Navigation drawer, rail, and bottom bar; adaptive navigation picks one by window width.
- [Progress](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/progress): Linear and circular progress indicators, usage meter for quotas (warning/critical thresholds).
- [Date Picker](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/date-picker): Modal or docked date picker and date range picker.
- [Time Picker](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/time-picker): Clock-dial dialog, 12- or 24-hour.
- [Calendar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/calendar): `lit-material-calendar` — `view="month|week|day|agenda"`, `date` (ISO day), `events` `{id,title,start,end?,allDay?,color?,editable?}[]` (Dates or ISO strings, local time zone; JSON attr for SSR), `first-day-of-week`, `slot-minutes`, `day-max-events`, `agenda-days`, `readonly`; events `event-click` `{event}`, `slot-click` `{start,end,allDay}`, cancelable `event-change` `{event,start,end,allDay}` (controlled: the app updates `events`), `navigate` `{view,date,start,end}`.
- [Autocomplete](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/autocomplete): Text field with a filtered, data-driven option list.
- [Accordion](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/accordion): Expansion panels, single- or multi-expand.
- [Stepper](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/stepper): Wizard-progress indicator, horizontal or vertical, linear or free; `lit-material-checklist` + `-item` (`label`, `done`; `dismissible`, `storage-key`) from `@lit-material/stepper/checklist.js`.
- [Tree](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/tree): Hierarchical expand-collapse list, single- or multi-select.
- [Avatar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/avatar): Image, initials, or icon fallback.
- [Skeleton](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/skeleton): Loading placeholder — text, circular, rectangular, rounded.
- [Rating](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/rating): Star rating, native range input foundation, hover preview.
- [Speed Dial](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/speed-dial): Expandable FAB menu, built on the Popover API.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/breadcrumbs): Nav landmark showing the current page's place in a hierarchy.
- [Toolbar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/toolbar): Grouped controls above a piece of content, with a trailing spacer.
- [Panel](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/panel): Generic content container with optional header/footer bands.
- [Sidebar](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/sidebar): Two-pane layout — fixed-width side panel next to flexible content.
- [Page](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/page): App-shell grid: header row plus a sidebar/main-content row.
- [Drawer](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/drawer): Non-modal, persistent overlay panel — e.g. a notification drawer.
- [Description List](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/description-list): Metadata display — a set of term/description pairs.
- [Data List](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/data-list): Flexible, multi-cell rows, optionally expandable.
- [Simple List](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/simple-list): Plain, lightweight list of links or buttons.
- [Alert](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/alert): Persistent inline/page-level banner — distinct from the snackbar toast.
- [Code Block](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/code-block): Monospace code container with a copy button and optional truncation; `lit-material-code-field` edits YAML/JSON (line numbers, Tab indent, `language="json"` or `validator` check).
- [File Upload](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/file-upload): Drag-and-drop or click-to-browse file picking, single or multiple.
- [Timestamp](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/timestamp): Absolute or live-updating relative date/time display.
- [Popover](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/popover): Richer, click-triggered overlay content — distinct from the tooltip.
- [Icon](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/icon): Sizing/colour wrapper for any icon; `registerIcons({ name: svg })` then `<lit-material-icon name>` or `icon(name)`.
- [Overflow Menu](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/overflow-menu): Responsive action row that collapses overflow into a kebab menu.
- [Color Scheme](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/color-scheme): `lit-material-color-scheme-toggle` (light/dark, or light/dark/system with `cycle`), `setColorScheme()`, `colorSchemeBootScript()` for a no-flash `<head>` script.
- [Clipboard](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/clipboard): `copyText()` (Clipboard API with execCommand fallback, resolves ok), `lit-material-copy-button` (`value` or `for`), `lit-material-clipboard-copy` (read-only value + copy, `masked`), `lit-material-new-secret` (`value`, `label`, slot `actions`: a secret shown once).
- [Sign in](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/sign-in): `lit-material-sign-in` — `methods="password code sign-up forgot"`, `mode`, `method`, `awaiting-code`, `busy`, `error`, `notice`; fires `lit-material-sign-in` `{mode, method, email, password?, code?}`; slots `providers`, `logo`, `footer`.
- [Pricing](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/pricing): `lit-material-plan-picker` `.plans` `{id,name,price:{amount}|{monthly,yearly},features,current,recommended,action,disabled,hint}[]`, `period`; fires `lit-material-plan-select` `{plan, period}`; `lit-material-plan-card`.
- [Confirm](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/confirm): `await confirm({ headline, message, confirmLabel, destructive, requireText })` resolves true/false; `lit-material-confirm-dialog` element.
- [Key/value editor](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/key-value): `lit-material-key-value-editor` — `.entries` `{key,value}[]`, `change` event, `toObject()`, `checkValidity()`, `key-pattern`, `mask-values`; `parseKeyValues()` for `.env` paste.
- [Split panel](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/split-panel): `lit-material-split-panel` — slots `start`/`end`, `position` %, `min`/`max`, `orientation`; separator keyboard (arrows, Home/End, Enter collapse); `change` `{position}`.
- [Format](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/format): functions `formatBytes`, `formatNumber`, `formatDuration`, `formatCpu`, `parseQuantity("512Mi")` — Intl-based, Node/SSR safe.
- [Sortable](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/sortable): `lit-material-sortable` — wraps items (`data-sort-id`, `[data-sort-handle]`); fires `sort` `{from, to, fromList, toList}`, app reorders data; `group` for cross-list; `layout="grid"` for card grids/rows; keyboard Space/arrows.
- [Jump links](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/jump-links): `lit-material-jump-links` — `links` `{id,text,depth?}[]` (property, or JSON attribute for SSR) or `for="<container id>"`; anchors + `aria-current="location"` scrollspy; `offset` for sticky headers.
- [Truncate](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/truncate): `lit-material-truncate` — `value`, `position="end|middle"`, `tail-length`; reflects `truncated`, sets `title` while cut.
- [Site kit](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/site-kit): no shadow DOM; templates `faq(items,{exclusive})`, `steps`, `terminal(lines,{label})`, `kbd(...keys)`, `shortcuts`, `searchDialog`, `searchButton`, `themeToggle`, `menuToggle` from `/templates.js`; scripts `initThemeToggle({key})` + inline `themeBootScript(key)`, `initMenu`, `initSearch({load,emptyHint})` (Pagefind, `/` and Ctrl/Cmd+K), `initTerminal`, `initReveal`; CSS `css/site-kit.css` in a cascade layer.
- [Back to top](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/back-to-top): `lit-material-back-to-top` — `threshold`, `target` (id: link + scroll + focus), `label`; reflects `visible`; reduced-motion aware.
- [Rich text](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/rich-text): `lit-material-rich-text-editor` — `value` (HTML, sanitized to p/h2/h3/strong/em/u/s/code/pre/blockquote/ul/ol/li/a[href]/br, `""` when empty), `label`, `placeholder`, `supporting-text`, `error-text`, `required`, `maxlength`, `name` (form-associated), `readonly`, `disabled`; `command(name, value?)`, `getText()`, `getMarkdown()`; `input`/`change`; links only http(s)/mailto/relative; no Trusted Types policy needed.
- [Inline edit](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/inline-edit): `lit-material-inline-edit` — `value`, `label`, `.save` (async, return/throw a message to stay open), `.validator`, `change` `{value, previous}`.
- [Dual list selector](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/dual-list): `lit-material-dual-list-selector` — `.items` `{value,label,disabled?}[]`, `.selected`, `filterable`, `change` `{selected}`; listbox keyboard support.
- [Status](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/status): Icon + label coloured by state (ok, warning, error, info, neutral) — never colour alone.
- [Stat](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/stat): Dashboard tile: label, large tabular value, caption or trend.
- [Empty State](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/empty-state): Headline, guidance and actions in place of a blank view.
- [Diff](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/diff): `lit-material-diff` — `original`, `modified` (strings), `mode="unified|split"`, `context` (-1 = all), `label`; `lit-material-change-list` `.changes` `{path,kind,before,after}[]` (JSON attr for SSR); `lit-material-merge-view` `.sides` `{label,text}[]`, `base` index, slots `side-<i>`; `diffLines`/`sideBySide`/`hunks`/`stats` from `@lit-material/diff/lines.js`.
- [Log Viewer](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/log-viewer): Monospace line stream that follows the newest line, with pause, highlighting and a line cap.
- [Table](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/table): Data-driven semantic `<table>`: caption, headers, numeric and monospace columns.
- [Chart](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/chart): Line chart, bar chart (with one highlighted item) and sparkline: crosshair tooltip, keyboard access, screen-reader table.
- [Timing waterfall](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/timing-waterfall): `lit-material-timing-waterfall` — `.timings` `{dnsMs, connectMs, waitMs, downloadMs, totalMs?, reused?}` (JSON attr for SSR) or `.phases` `[{label, ms, color?}]`; one stacked bar (role=img, named with every phase) + legend with ms and total, "Reused connection" note; `hide-legend`; colours `--lit-material-timing-waterfall-{dns,connect,wait,download}`.
- [Method tag](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/method-tag): `lit-material-method-tag` — `method` (shown uppercase), `size` small|medium; GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE coloured, others primary (`--lit-material-method-tag-{get,post,put,patch,delete,other}`); `methodKind()` exported.
- [World map](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/world-map): `lit-material-world-map` — `data` `{US: 120, de: 40}` (ISO alpha-2, any case; JSON attr for SSR), `label`, `unit`, `selectable` + `selected`, `.format`; `change` `{code, value}` (`""`/`null` when cleared); square-root shading of one colour, legend, countries too small to draw listed under the map; `COUNTRIES`/`VIEWBOX` exported.

## App shell

- [Router](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/router): Path matching, nested routes, redirects and guards, lazy routes, typed query parameters, page titles, scroll restoration, server-side resolution for prerendering; an SPA route outlet and a route-reading controller; `setRouterMode("hash")` + `routeHref()` for static hosting.
- [Store](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/store): A dependency-free, Redux-shaped state store.
- [Core](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/core): Ripple/focus-ring controllers, `LocalizeController`/`registerTranslation`/`isRtl` (in `@lit-material/core/localize.js`), `themeContext`, `localeContext`.
- [Translations](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/translations): catalogs for the components' own text (`import de from "@lit-material/translations/de.js"; registerTranslation(de)`): ar, de, es, fr, ja, pl, uk; English built in. Components read the nearest `lang` attribute and mirror under `dir="rtl"`.
- [Task](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/task): `TaskController` for async work; with `key` it caches in `taskCache` (stale-while-revalidate, `staleTime`, dedup, `invalidate(prefix)`, `set`), plus `retry`/`retryDelay`, `refetchOnFocus`/`refetchOnReconnect`/`refetchInterval`.
- [HTTP](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/http): `createHttp({ baseUrl, headers, timeout, interceptors })` → `get/post/put/patch/delete`, JSON in and out, `HttpError` for non-2xx, interceptors with `retry()` for 401 refresh.
- [Form](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/form): `FormController(host, { form, validators, schema })`: `values` (dotted names nest), sync/async validators, Standard Schema (zod/valibot/arktype), errors shown on fields, `handleSubmit(onValid)`; `FieldArrayController` for repeating rows.
- [Vite](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/vite): `litMaterial({ prerender })` plugin; `index.html` with `<!--app-head-->`/`<!--app-html-->`; `src/entry-server.ts` exports `routes` and `render()`; `src/main.ts` imports `@lit-material/vite/client` first; `createRequestHandler`/`toNodeListener` from `@lit-material/vite/server` for production.
- [Testing](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/testing): `fixture()`, `cleanup()`, `waitForUpdate()`, `getByRole(role, { name })`, `getByLabel`, `getByText`, `findBy*`, `queryDeep` — through shadow roots; `user.click/type/press`.
- [Devtools](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/devtools): dev-only `connectStore(store)` (Redux DevTools extension, time travel via `store.replaceState`), `connectRouter()`, and the `<lit-material-devtools>` panel from `@lit-material/devtools/panel.js`.
- [Codemod](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/codemod): `npx @lit-material/codemod md-web <paths> [--dry-run]` rewrites `@material/web` to lit-material (HTML, Lit templates, JSX/TSX, CSS): `md-filled-button` → `lit-material-button variant="filled"`, renamed attributes/slots/events, `@material/web/<x>.js` imports → `@lit-material/<pkg>`; warnings with file:line for anything unmapped. `transform(source, file)` → `{ code, changes, warnings, packages }`.
- [create-lit-material-app](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/create-lit-material-app): `npm create lit-material-app` — a scaffolded starting point with the above wired together.
- [Tokens](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/packages/tokens): Color, type, shape, elevation, and motion design tokens every component reads from. Opt-in `css/typography.css`: `.md-typescale-<role>-<size>` classes and `.lit-material-content` prose (include via `unsafeCSS` inside shadow roots).

## Guides

- [README](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/blob/main/README.md): Why Lit/lit-material, install instructions, the full package list, and development commands.
- create-lit-material-app `--template console`: SaaS console starter (org switcher, adaptive navigation, sign-in, members, settings tabs, checklist).
- [Building apps guide](https://lit.rws8.tech/guides/building-apps/): Router + store + context + task + form wired together in one example.
- [Migrate from @material/web](https://lit.rws8.tech/guides/migrate-material-web/): same `--md-sys-*` tokens; the codemod and its element-by-element table; what needs manual work.
- [Migrate from Angular Material](https://lit.rws8.tech/guides/migrate-angular-material/): `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA`, bindings, forms (`ngDefaultControl` for text fields and sliders, `(change)` or your own accessor for select/checkbox/switch), component table, dialog/snackbar services as elements.

- [Versioning and support](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/blob/main/VERSIONING.md): every package shares one version (install them at the same version); semver, what counts as public API, deprecation (a minor ahead, 6 months), previous major supported 12 months; browsers and Node supported.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, every CI check and the command for it, component conventions (localize, RTL, CSP, SSR, a11y), changesets, the RFC process in `rfcs/`.

## Optional

- [Docs site](https://lit.rws8.tech/): Every component's live demo, install line, size and API tables, plus guides and the theme builder. Source at [apps/site](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/apps/site).
- [App-shell demo](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/tree/main/apps/app-shell-demo): A small runnable app showing router/store/context together (private, unpublished).
- [License](https://github.com/bohdaq/lit-material/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
